title: Recurring Charge Readback
summary: Reads back what a subscribe button really commits to: today's charge, first real charge, price step-ups and the cancel-by time.
description: Readback beside a subscribe button: charged today, when the first real charge and any intro price step-up land, and the cancel-by time with zone. Flags trials too short to cancel in time and button text that disagrees with the charge.
catches: Amount charged today, including small card checks
Date of the first real charge after a trial
Intro price ending and the step-up amount
Cancel-by time, with time zone, using cancelNoticeHours
Button wording ("free", a monthly price on yearly billing) that contradicts the charge
Optional India e-mandate notes (24-hour pre-debit alert, approval above a limit)
limits: Only reads back the plan you describe; it does not charge or schedule anything
Month arithmetic depends on billingTimeZone; pass the zone your biller renews in
The e-mandate notes describe RBI rules as of the verified date; they do not apply outside India
a11y: Renders as a polite live region; give your subscribe button aria-describedby pointing at its id
Warnings use an icon plus text; icons are aria-hidden
server: Charge the amounts and dates your billing system computes, not the client's; send the required pre-debit notices from the server or issuer.

rules.note: Informational. Confirmed: issuer pre-transaction notice at least 24 hours before debit; recurring debits up to ₹15,000 without AFA (₹1,00,000 for insurance premiums, mutual fund subscriptions and credit card bills; the default mandateLimit covers only the general case). Check the official source.

stops: Free trial quietly became a paid plan
